spans.s:
Dhaivara means a ‘fisherman,’ as a member of a caste,^1 in
the list of victims at the Puruṣamedha, or ‘human sacrifice,’ in
the Yajurveda.^2 Cf.

) This seems to be shown by the
patronymic form, ‘descendant of a
dhīvara.’
2) Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xxx. 16; Tait
tirīya Brāhmaṇa, iii. 4, 15, 1.
